pages.text: Here is what I tell my followers. I want to talk about SACCOs today. In my view this is the best choice for ordinary savers. I am strongly positive about it and tell everyone I know. Members should read the annual report and attend the general meeting.

Members contribute share capital and savings deposits and may borrow against their deposits. Leave your comments below and I will reply. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
